## What's new since 1.0.0-alpha.2

### Your ship responds sooner
- The client no longer draws your own ship a frame behind: it predicts it forward from the newest frame
  the server sent and blends corrections in over a few screen frames. Your keys still take a round trip
  to the server; predicting them on the client is future work (`docs/latency-fixes.md`).

### Client
- Race mode: the score list is ordered by race progress and shows each racer's lap and checkpoint;
  the next checkpoint comes from the server; bases show their owner's name.
- Alliances: allied ships are drawn as friends, and the score list marks your allies.
- The server's message of the day opens in a panel when you join, on JXPilot and XPilot servers.
- Temporary (hyperjump) wormholes are drawn; the radar shows the next race checkpoint; asteroids have
  their XPilot outlines.
- Items are drawn as XPilot draws them: mine owner names (`showMineName`, including "Expired" and
  "Not of this world!"), the ECM circle's size, the lock distance only when the server sends one, a
  beam only when both ends are on screen.
- `showItems` and `showItemsTime` work; Keypad 8 (`keyToggleOwnedItems`) toggles the item list and
  Keypad 9 (`keyToggleMessages`) the messages; the refuel, repair and tank keys show your fuel.
- Every XPilot client resource is accepted in `~/.xpilotrc` or as `--RESOURCE VALUE`; `name`, `team`
  and the HUD, item and message resources take effect. XPilot's settings panel and font resources are
  still to come.

### Server behaves like XPilot's in more places
- **The server now quits when the last human player leaves, and when nobody joins within 5 minutes,
  as XPilot's does. Pass `-noQuit` (or `noQuit: yes` in the config file) for a server that waits for
  players.** The examples and scripts do.
- A full server puts newcomers in a login queue (20 places, 2 per address); the client shows
  "Waiting in queue on HOST (position N)". `/queue` shows the line, operators use `/advance NAME`.
- `maxClientsPerIP` now defaults to 2, as in XPilot.
- `motdFileName`: players see the server's message of the day in a panel when they join (`F1` closes
  it).
- `/set` has XPilot's side effects for every option, including `teamCannons`; a `robotTeam` outside
  0-9 becomes 0. `/set` and `/get` show the value the server really uses (`/set maxArmor 500` gives 99).
- Option numbers are read as XPilot reads them (hexadecimal works); `inf` and `nan` are refused.
- `/password`: after 3 wrong tries a wait of 10 seconds, doubling up to 5 minutes ("Too many wrong
  passwords.  Try again in N seconds."). An empty password works as in XPilot, with a warning at
  start-up.
- Chat messages are cut to 79 characters, as in XPilot.
- `/set shipMass` also applies to new asteroids; `/set minVisibilityDistance` and
  `maxVisibilityDistance` work.
- Game modes, closer to XPilot: temporary wormholes without a limit, as in XPilot; detached tanks take
  no part in races; lasers hit asteroids; ball, target and race fixes; the `gameDuration` log line.
- A player over `maxClientsPerIP` is refused with "too many players from your address" (XPilot's
  "game locked" reason code).

### Items, closer to XPilot
- Modifier banks from your keys file (`modifierBank1` to `modifierBank4`) are sent when you join.
- The locked player blinks on the radar; the HUD marks the item selected for dropping; an ECM that
  reprograms a robot tells everyone.
- The client tells the server its view size, so paused and other players get XPilot's update rates
  and views.

### For developers
- 21 golden item traces (new: arena detonation, ECM detaching a ball, an item lost while moving right),
  replayed with C's particle slot order and flak; the exhaust sparks' random draws are a documented
  deviation. 15 game-mode golden traces (balls, targets, treasures, races, asteroids, team rounds)
  replay the C server's random draws and game messages through one C replay mechanism, with C's cell
  order for collisions. Reference-harness patches 0006
  (`XPILOT_TRACE_RAND`) and 0007 (`XPILOT_TRACE_ROBOT`). Why robots sometimes get stuck (as XPilot's
  do): `server/src/test/resources/robots/README.md`.
